$comment: The one declaration of the IPL store schema. Read by the maintenance tool (provision, verify-schema) and by Infrastructure/main.bicep. Change containers here and nowhere else. Partition keys can never change on an existing container.

containers.name: inventory
containers.why: One partition value (default) so one transactional batch can deduct several products, create the checkout marker and write the ledger atomically.

containers.name: products
containers.why: The catalogue is browsed per franchise; price audit rows sit next to their product so both commit in one batch.

containers.name: carts
containers.why: Every cart read and write is for one user; the cart change and its idempotency record share a partition so they commit together. TTL must stay on: carts expire after 30 days and idempotency records after their own 24-hour ttl.

containers.name: orders
containers.why: Order history is always one user, newest first.

containers.name: migrations
containers.why: One record per data migration, looked up by id; its _etag lets only one runner claim a migration.
